title: Fourier norm as a sum over degrees
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Its Fourier one norm equals the sum, over degrees $k=0,1,\ldots,n$, of the Fourier one norms of the degree-$k$ parts of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
